question: In a certain code language ACCOUNT is written as ‘EBGNYMX’ and MANOR is written as ‘QZRNV’. How will PATTERN be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32770a41ec977af2dbb04b2c1d6f230ef042728ed79e49316de972bbb5af777d.png] 

**ACCOUNT: EBGNYMX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5737f3fc1eedb873d92d4c37d9736daf16bc3a7f22a71df2169c8913118eabd.png] 

**MANOR: QZRNV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/159387dddb4270a3cb8090440a2e14de8f8117573d4bfb49da791331ca53734f.png] 

Similarly,

**PATTERN: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9bc52ba0cd6dc39876f6b0ec1da1ebf030b734d24b02939261fa747d540aec0.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****TZXSIQR"**.
